original_items.title: Submodel information aspect
original_items.native_meaning: Submodel is a globally identifiable information aspect of the represented asset; submodelElement has cardinality 0..*.
original_items.caveat: An information group is not an installed subsystem.

original_items.title: Template and instance
original_items.native_meaning: Submodel kind propagates template/instance interpretation to contained elements. semanticId is recommended. Validators treat Submodel like a collection rather than a list.
original_items.caveat: No new DIM class hierarchy or physical asset-kind rule follows.

original_items.title: SubmodelElement abstract base
original_items.native_meaning: Abstract SubmodelElement inherits Referable, HasSemantics, Qualifiable and HasDataSpecification. A semanticId is recommended; semantic property-definition attributes may need an external lookup.
original_items.caveat: The base is not an observation, command, physical component or proof of interoperability.

original_items.title: Optional values
original_items.native_meaning: Value-related attributes are typically optional so the same structures can describe templates.
original_items.caveat: A missing value is not a measured zero or an explicit empty update.

original_items.title: Property
original_items.native_meaning: A single-value DataElement has required valueType, optional value and optional coded-value reference valueId.
original_items.caveat: Property is broader than a measured observable; subject, timing and source are not established by this class alone.

original_items.title: MultiLanguageProperty
original_items.native_meaning: A DataElement can carry a multilingual value and optional valueId.
original_items.caveat: Translated value text is distinct from a field display label and from separate measurements.

original_items.title: Range
original_items.native_meaning: Range has required valueType and optional min/max values; the class is explicitly Experimental.
original_items.caveat: This alone does not define allowed/excluded values, endpoint inclusion, calibration limits or measured uncertainty.

original_items.title: File locator
original_items.native_meaning: File is a DataElement whose optional value is an absolute or relative file URI; contentType is optional. Package-relative interpretation is explained.
original_items.caveat: A file locator does not prove file access, media acquisition, observation association or AASX package conformance.

original_items.title: Embedded Blob
original_items.native_meaning: Blob stores file content directly in its optional value; contentType is optional.
original_items.caveat: Embedded bytes and an external file locator are different representations.

original_items.title: ReferenceElement
original_items.native_meaning: A DataElement holds an optional logical reference within/across shells or an external reference.
original_items.caveat: A reference is not evidence of a cable, physical attachment or reachable network service.

original_items.title: RelationshipElement endpoints and meaning
original_items.native_meaning: semanticId supplies relationship meaning. first is the subject reference and second the object reference; each is 0..1 in v3.2. AnnotatedRelationshipElement SHALL be used when the semantic definition requires information outside the endpoints.
original_items.caveat: Do not import older-edition required endpoints or infer physical part-of from this general relation.

original_items.title: AnnotatedRelationshipElement
original_items.native_meaning: Adds 0..* DataElement annotations to a relationship; the annotations qualify the relationship between its endpoints.
original_items.caveat: The annotation vocabulary and relationship meaning still require source evidence.

original_items.title: Entity and statements
original_items.native_meaning: Entity models parts of composite assets such as a bill of materials. Statements are 0..* SubmodelElements; entityType and globalAssetId are 0..1, specificAssetId 0..*.
original_items.caveat: Design composition does not prove installed configuration. Empty Inherits-from prose is qualified using pinned schema and local diagram sources.

original_items.title: Co-managed and self-managed entities
original_items.native_meaning: CoManagedEntity has no separate shell and belongs to a self-managed entity; SelfManagedEntity has its own shell and may also belong to a composite self-managed entity.
original_items.caveat: Shell-management boundaries do not establish device taskability, physical independence or native CSAPI subsystem rules.

original_items.title: Collection named structure
original_items.native_meaning: SubmodelElementCollection groups multiple named values, typically a semantically predefined set. Members are not ordered and have unique idShort names; following template order is recommended. value is 0..*.
original_items.caveat: Not an installed component container or a guarantee that every member has a distinct semanticId.

original_items.title: List structure
original_items.native_meaning: SubmodelElementList stores a zero-indexed sequence with required typeValueListElement; orderRelevant is optional with default true. Optional semanticIdListElement/valueTypeListElement qualify children; value is 0..*.
original_items.caveat: The prose discusses sets and bags, but orderRelevant alone does not prove uniqueness or define ISA min/max length and tree-depth bounds.

original_items.title: Recursive information examples
original_items.native_meaning: Lists of lists can represent multidimensional arrays; collections of column lists can represent tables; a list of collections can represent documents.
original_items.caveat: Publisher structural examples are not observed equipment trees or a mandated common Details-view layout.

original_items.title: List naming and reference position
original_items.native_meaning: References distinguish model and external targets, retain ordered keys, and may carry a recommended semantic expectation. References must not be treated as locators.
original_items.caveat: Exact reference-chain and list-position rules are separately recorded; full reference examples/algorithms remain outside this increment.

original_items.title: Semantic identifiers
original_items.native_meaning: HasSemantics provides optional main semanticId and 0..* supplementalSemanticId; supplemental IDs require a main ID under AASd-118.
original_items.caveat: The AAS02 overview-versus-cardinality wording question remains open; no mandatory universal semanticId is adopted.

original_items.title: ConceptDescription
original_items.native_meaning: ConceptDescription defines semantics, is Identifiable, uses data specifications and may reference compatible/derived external definitions via isCaseOf 0..*. Prose expects at least one data specification.
original_items.caveat: isCaseOf does not establish exact equivalence. The inherited reference cardinality and prose expectation need contextual validation, not an invented DIM SHALL.

original_items.title: Data specification versus Submodel template
original_items.native_meaning: A data specification template defines additional attributes, has a globally unique ID and content, and belongs to separately maintained specifications. Several templates can apply.
original_items.caveat: It differs from a Submodel template; the Part 1 IEC 61360 diagram is expressly non-normative and does not audit Part 3a/3b.

original_items.title: HasDataSpecification
original_items.native_meaning: An element references 0..* data specification templates by global ID.
original_items.caveat: Normal JSON uses embeddedDataSpecifications instead; concept-description prose does not make the inherited generic cardinality universally mandatory.

original_items.title: Qualifier and three kinds
original_items.native_meaning: Qualifier has required type/valueType and optional value/valueId. ValueQualifier concerns an instance value, ConceptQualifier the semantic definition, and TemplateQualifier template metadata; kind defaults to ConceptQualifier and the attribute is Experimental.
original_items.caveat: Quality, as-planned/as-maintained and mandatory/optional examples need actual qualifier definitions. External IEC/DIN sources and the embedded image are not audited here.

original_items.title: Template identifier provenance
original_items.native_meaning: AdministrativeInformation.templateId records which template guided creation; its note directs validation to Submodel.semanticId instead.
original_items.caveat: Creation provenance is not a complete template-validation contract.

original_items.title: Normal JSON empty aggregation rule
original_items.native_meaning: Normal JSON forbids empty aggregation arrays; an empty aggregation is represented by omitting the attribute. Singular metamodel association names generally become plural JSON keys.
original_items.caveat: This representation does not preserve ISA supplied-empty versus omitted-update distinctions by itself; Part 2 update behavior remains unreviewed.

original_items.title: Normal JSON value representation
original_items.native_meaning: Property.value and Range.min/max are JSON strings interpreted using valueType; BlobType uses base64. ValueOnly is a different representation; round trips may change lexical form.
original_items.caveat: Native encoding is not a new DIM datatype; full ValueOnly/XML/RDF behavior is not audited here.

original_items.title: Discriminator and embedded specifications
original_items.native_meaning: Normal JSON uses allOf for inherited constraints, modelType as a serialization discriminator, and embeddedDataSpecifications rather than the metamodel dataSpecification reference attribute.
original_items.caveat: modelType is expressly not a metamodel attribute. Serialization mechanics are retained as native evidence, not universal equipment fields.

original_items.title: Semantic matching strategies
original_items.native_meaning: The annex distinguishes exact-reference matching, value matching and knowledge-dependent compatible matching. Examples may require edition/dictionary knowledge; one proposed mapping is explicitly only a candidate.
original_items.caveat: Matching labels or identifier text does not prove exact semantic equivalence. Full reference algorithm and external dictionaries are unreviewed.

original_items.title: Operation structural boundary
original_items.native_meaning: Operation has three 0..* variable collections. OperationVariable wraps exactly one SubmodelElement; variable idShort values must be unique. Cardinality/default extensions are described as future possibilities.
original_items.caveat: Structure read here; invocation, outcomes, authorization and CSAPI Command comparison are deferred to AAS04/Part 2 review.

original_items.title: Capability structural boundary
original_items.native_meaning: Capability expresses implementation-independent potential to achieve an effect; the note discusses semantic links to skills.
original_items.caveat: Do not infer current readiness, implementation or achieved effect. Capability meaning/comparison is AAS04.

original_items.title: Experimental event structures
original_items.native_meaning: BasicEventElement has observed/direction/state, optional messaging and interval fields; EventPayload has event-source/scope references and a trigger timestamp. EventPayload is outside AASX information-model exchange according to its note.
original_items.caveat: Read as element inventory only here. Event lifecycle, lastUpdate versus trigger time and interface semantics are deferred to AAS04/Part 2; no observation-equivalence claim.

original_items.title: Abstract DataElement and EventElement
original_items.native_meaning: DataElement is not composed of other SubmodelElements and carries a value or predefined number of values. Categories are deprecated.
original_items.caveat: Abstract classes are not concrete JSON choice alternatives; EventElement separately remains abstract and Experimental.

original_items.title: Element-type enumeration
original_items.native_meaning: AasSubmodelElements lists both abstract and concrete types, while the original JSON SubmodelElement_choice contains 14 concrete alternatives.
original_items.caveat: An enumeration count is not a count of adopted DIM classes. Native type grammar and per-instance conformance remain distinct.

original_items.title: Capability describes potential
original_items.native_meaning: Capability is an implementation-independent description of an asset potential to achieve a physical or virtual effect; the class adds no own attributes beyond inherited SubmodelElement information.
original_items.caveat: A capability declaration is not availability, execution, readiness or a measured achieved effect.

original_items.title: Capability-to-skill relationship
original_items.native_meaning: The note describes semantic relationship links from a capability to skills; typical implementations may use a property, operation, collection or whole submodel.
original_items.caveat: The external 2020 capabilities paper and ontology contents remain unread; no one-to-one capability/command mapping is established.

original_items.title: Operation description and invocation boundary
original_items.native_meaning: Operation describes input, output and inoutput variable lists; Part 1 points to Part 2 synchronous/asynchronous invocation. Instance and template operation specifications are handled identically.
original_items.caveat: This is a description of an interface; Part 2 execution, errors, acceptance/completion and cancellation contracts remain unreviewed.

original_items.title: Operation argument/result and future optionality
original_items.native_meaning: Each of the three variable lists is 0..*; each OperationVariable contains exactly one SubmodelElement value describing an argument/result. Default value and optional/mandatory cardinality on OperationVariable are mentioned as future extension examples.
original_items.caveat: The wrapper value cardinality is not proof that an operation argument is mandatory; do not invent the future fields or ISA parameter equivalence.

original_items.title: Experimental event model
original_items.native_meaning: The event concept remains experimental and future backward compatibility is not ensured.
original_items.caveat: Keep this standing on every event-derived mapping; it is not an adopted stable DIM event class.

original_items.title: Observed referable
original_items.native_meaning: BasicEventElement.observed is a required reference to a modeled Referable such as a data element or Submodel; direction is required input or output.
original_items.caveat: The observed target is an information-model object, not automatically a physical feature of interest or an OGC observation.

original_items.title: Event on/off state
original_items.native_meaning: BasicEventElement.state is required and uses StateOfEvent on/off literals.
original_items.caveat: This is the state of the event, not a device health taxonomy, selected operating mode or command readiness.

original_items.title: Event infrastructure hints
original_items.native_meaning: Optional messageTopic and messageBroker identify outer communication routing and a referable containing proprietary broker details; the note suggests possible standardized submodels.
original_items.caveat: This does not establish a configured transport, delivery guarantee, authorization or interoperability of the broker description.

original_items.title: Last event send or receive time
original_items.native_meaning: Optional lastUpdate is UTC time of the last event received for input direction or sent for output direction.
original_items.caveat: This is a last-event timestamp, not a timestamp on every exchange, a measured phenomenon time or general record modification time.

original_items.title: Minimum event interval
original_items.native_meaning: Optional minInterval limits maximum event frequency; input concerns the handling capability of the software entity, output concerns sending frequency to outer infrastructure.
original_items.caveat: Not a sensor sampling interval or automatically ISA minimum Status interval; absence means no minimum interval is specified.

original_items.title: Maximum output event interval
original_items.native_meaning: maxInterval is not applicable to input; for output it describes a maximum interval for sending an event-status update even without another trigger.
original_items.caveat: Not an operation to change the interval and not a universal component heartbeat or sensor reporting contract; source sentence contains awkward double-negative wording.

original_items.title: Event payload source and scope references
original_items.native_meaning: EventPayload requires source (event element) and observableReference (referable defining scope); semantic references for each are optional and external references are recommended.
original_items.caveat: No dedicated occurrence ID or original-event-to-copy lineage is supplied by these source/scope references.

original_items.title: Event trigger time
original_items.native_meaning: EventPayload.timestamp is required UTC time when the event was triggered.
original_items.caveat: Trigger time is not automatically physical phenomenon time, observation result time, or exchange send time; no leap/clock conformance is asserted.

original_items.title: Event initiator attribution
original_items.native_meaning: Optional subjectId identifies who or what initiated creation; the note calls it an external reference and assumes a unique subject identifier.
original_items.caveat: A field naming an initiator is not proof of authentication, authorization, evidence provenance or identity correctness; NIST ABAC reference remains unread.

original_items.title: Custom event type and payload
original_items.native_meaning: Event types use semanticId and specialized payloads; custom types may use proprietary worldwide-unique semantic IDs and customized payloads within the general event-message format.
original_items.caveat: The examples do not define a universal event-reason enumeration, detector snapshot, health vocabulary or complete transport protocol.

original_items.title: Condition, execution and audit event use cases
original_items.native_meaning: Firmware notices, condition-monitoring incidents, change tracking and cloud value push motivate event use. The later table also lists execution monitoring, infrastructure and security events.
original_items.caveat: Motivating use cases and illustrations do not supply mandatory execution-state, alarm, condition or history payload schemas.

original_items.title: Logical event scope
original_items.native_meaning: The event scope can cover an AAS, a Submodel and its logical dependents, a collection/list/entity and dependents, or one atomic element.
original_items.caveat: Logical scope is not physical equipment containment or a guarantee that all physical events are observed.

original_items.title: Condition values and value quality
original_items.native_meaning: Qualifier type/value adds context to values or semantics; semanticId is recommended. Generic properties may represent actual/runtime values and qualifiers can indicate measured or substitute value quality.
original_items.caveat: A generic carrier is not a standardized equipment operating-condition vocabulary or an authenticated current reading.

original_items.title: Administrative version and revision
original_items.native_meaning: AdministrativeInformation has optional version, revision, creator, createdAt and updatedAt; revision requires version through AASd-005.
original_items.caveat: Versions concern the identifiable information element, not automatically hardware, firmware or current sensor configuration.

original_items.title: Business creation/update milestones
original_items.native_meaning: createdAt remains tied to object identity; updatedAt tracks relevant modifications and cannot precede creation. The note treats version/revision/dates as business milestones and does not require updates for every transient data change.
original_items.caveat: These timestamps do not establish last acquisition, live freshness, connectivity or technical system modification time.

original_items.title: Distinguishing semantically similar submodels
original_items.native_meaning: Two Submodels with the same semanticId must be distinguished by the listed administrative/semantic alternatives; revision alone is ignored for the version alternative, and the stated presence conditions apply. Distinct Submodel IDs remain required.
original_items.caveat: Do not treat version, creator or dates as a universal asset identity rule; the no-semanticId/no-templateId note also limits formal comparison.

original_items.title: Creator and template provenance
original_items.native_meaning: creator identifies the subject responsible for making the information element; templateId identifies the template guiding its creation and is not the validation key, which uses semanticId.
original_items.caveat: A record creator/template identifier does not authenticate an assertion or identify an installed unit; preserve prior AAS02/AAS03 provenance distinctions.

original_items.title: Version representation inconsistency
original_items.native_meaning: Administration prose calls version/revision numerical integer types, but the datatype tables define one-to-four-character digit strings and the selected JSON definition also uses strings.
original_items.caveat: Do not silently choose an integer wire encoding or claim the source inconsistency resolved.

original_items.title: UTC example inconsistency
original_items.native_meaning: DateTimeUtc is defined for UTC but includes an example with +01:00 as well as a Z example; the selected administration JSON patterns allow only zero-offset suffixes.
original_items.caveat: The conflict is retained for AAS05 schema corroboration; no local timezone conversion or exhaustive regex validity is inferred.

original_items.title: Proprietary extension standing
original_items.native_meaning: HasExtensions permits proprietary extensions; the source explicitly says these do not support global interoperability.
original_items.caveat: Availability of an extension mechanism is not acceptance into a common vocabulary or ISA Custom/Nominated/Accepted governance status.

original_items.title: Extension fields and local names
original_items.native_meaning: Extension has required name, optional valueType defaulting to xs:string, optional value and zero-or-more refersTo model references; it inherits semantics. AASd-077 requires unique names within the owner.
original_items.caveat: Names and typed values do not establish shared meaning, validation of vendor content or global name uniqueness.

original_items.title: Proprietary and templated submodels
original_items.native_meaning: The annex permits standardized and proprietary information in the same infrastructure; public or non-public templates can guide instantiation with predefined semantics and source-defined cardinalities.
original_items.caveat: No selected industrial template or external dictionary has been audited in AAS04; interpreting unknown manufacturer semantics remains conditional.

original_items.title: Event timestamp spelling across source forms
original_items.native_meaning: Pinned local UML partial spells timeStamp, while the native attribute table uses timestamp.
original_items.caveat: Retain the native attribute-table spelling; rendering and full cross-schema reconciliation remain AAS05 concerns.

original_items.title: Changing value qualifiers and static context
original_items.native_meaning: ValueQualifier may vary over time and is restricted to instances; ConceptQualifier is static semantic context; TemplateQualifier is static template context, with source constraints and the operation-variable exception.
original_items.caveat: As-planned/as-maintained examples are semantic context, not actual maintenance state or proof of live data quality; external qualifier dictionaries remain unread.

original_constraint_items.caveat: Native rule only; no runtime enforcement or DIM/Profile adoption claimed.

comparison_updates.clarification: AAS Asset-ID, AAS-ID and base64url HTTP path parameters are distinct from a persistent OGC CSAPI System identifier; discovery and lookup do not authenticate equipment.
Repository returns a digital Asset Administration Shell and registry returns its descriptor; neither proves a real sensing arrangement or that the descriptor is more authoritative than the shell.
A technology-specific AAS API service or endpoint is a network participant, but it is not automatically a network-visible physical sensor or participating hardware.
Registry descriptor endpoints and Submodel paths are informational service links, not verified external equipment cables or attachment.
AAS Registry, Repository, standalone Service and Discovery expose distinct 3.2 service profiles; Full, Read, Query, History and Signature do not imply the same mandatory command support.
/description profiles declare supported API-operation subsets; they are not an ISA equipment Config report or proof that commands are enabled and ready.
AAS Discovery -> Registry descriptor -> endpoint lookup is a source-defined software location chain, not a verified live physical network connection. Shell endpoint may be omitted.
AAS profile URI/version and HTTP serialization modifiers describe available API representation choices; versioned URL prefix and identity encoding are not guaranteed common CSAPI framing.
AAS and Submodel descriptors can expose separate endpoints but are not an observed source of installed component hierarchy or producer-origin equipment attribution.
Optional repository JWS retrieval concerns a digital-shell representation; it does not independently verify the source publisher, NOAA record, or an authenticated factual assertion.
Repository record-at-date history explicitly differs from AdministrativeInformation.version and from a physical component's current configuration/firmware version.
Protocol securityAttributes, generic 401/403 failure codes and optional JWS representation are not ISA request-user authorization metadata or verified issuer authentication.
Generic API HTTP 200/202/4xx statuses and Result objects can acknowledge software requests but do not establish sensing-device command completion, physical effect or ISA outcome.
